entities.name: Gorgon
entities.description: Snake-skinned humanoid women with snakes or snakelike tendrils for hair who petrify those who look at their faces.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker whose relationship with Vraska implies gorgons and humans are reproductively isolated.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker associated with the Golgari Swarm who took control of the guild.

entities.name: Visara
entities.description: A winged gorgon who was a pit fighter for the Cabal on Otaria.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Organization with pit fighters on Otaria.

entities.name: Sisters of Stone Death
entities.description: Gorgon guildmasters of the Golgari Swarm, reduced to one by Svogthir.

entities.name: Ludmilla
entities.description: The last surviving Sister of Stone Death, remaining in the Undercity.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose gorgons were its most downtrodden race.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Golgari parun who fought the Sisters of Stone Death.

entities.name: Xathrid
entities.description: A demonic creature worshiped by cults of Shandalar, employing gorgons.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: The god of Theros who created gorgons.

entities.name: Hythonia
entities.description: One of Theros's most powerful gorgons.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: Planeswalker who entered a gorgon's lair seeking an artifact.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God using Pharika's Spawn to keep souls in the Underworld.

entities.name: Pharika's Spawn
entities.description: Dangerous early creations of Pharika banished to the Underworld.

entities.name: Damia
entities.description: A gorgon sage whose arcane knowledge rivals any archmage.

events.summary: Svogthir and the Golgari reduce the Sisters of Stone Death to only Ludmilla.
events.quote: the Sisters of Stone Death were diminished to only one: Ludmilla

events.summary: Vraska takes control of the Golgari and becomes a voice for gorgons.
events.quote: When Vraska took control of the guild

events.summary: Dack Fayden enters a gorgon's lair searching for an artifact.
events.quote: Another gorgon was encountered by Dack Fayden when he entered her lair searching for a magical artifact.
